headline: TransDigm Group (TDG) Is Spending $1.07 Billion On An Aerospace Materials Deal
summary: TransDigm Group (NYSE: TDG) announced the acquisition of alloy materials supplier Prince & Izant, expanding its aerospace and defense product portfolio. The company also appointed Irina Krasik to its Board of Directors, adding experience in mergers, acquisitions, and investment strategy. These moves highlight TransDigm Group's continued use of M&A and board expertise to shape its product mix and capital allocation priorities.
